controls.evidence: The proxy reports UPGRADE_INTERFACE_VERSION 5.0.0 and resolves to implementation 0xaafe784a51f119d38e57717fd8a00f844bd86f13, but all tested owner/admin getters revert. Storage slot 0 points to 0x507ec48ef26919a205a9f3b8aaf69532e20c0987, itself a UUPS proxy with implementation 0x6e0f4dc0d748e4917b418357d989b2023b8b7a20 and no readable owner. review.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-07-20. Local metadata establishes sUSD1+ as a USD1 strategy-vault variant, so base USD1 supply authority remains inherited rather than copied into the child controls. At BSC block 111074113, the local proxy is an OZ 5 UUPS surface with implementation 0xaafe784a51f119d38e57717fd8a00f844bd86f13 and zero standard EIP-1967 admin/beacon slots. owner(), getOwner(), admin(), DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE(), and asset() did not identify a controller; slot 0's nested UUPS proxy also has no readable owner. No independent reconciliation or named prudential supervisor is established for this local strategy wrapper.

reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-3 (lead usdd-tron-dao-reserve)
reserveReview.rationale: Re-verified 2026-07-20 via Lorenzo's own USD1+ OTF guide: USD1+ is the first On-chain Traded Fund on Lorenzo's Financial Abstraction Layer on BNB Chain, aggregating RWA, CeFi quant-trading, and DeFi returns with all yield settled in USD1; sUSD1+ is the staked receipt minted against USD1 deposits at unit NAV, subject to a 7-day minimum hold and a biweekly withdrawal-settlement cycle back into USD1. The wrapper dependency on tracked USD1 (usd1-world-liberty-financial, depType wrapper) is therefore confirmed, but Lorenzo publishes no strategy-level weights or portfolio breakdown, so scope stays dependency-relationships rather than full-composition. Risk stays high: a delta-neutral sleeve alone would tier medium, but the managed strategy runs through undisclosed off-chain CeFi execution with unverified wrapper upgrade authority, so the riskier tier is kept.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Lorenzo USD1+ OTF issuer guide and protocol documentation fetched 2026-07-20
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The linked USD1 wrapper relationship is disclosed; the internal allocation across RWA, CeFi quant, and DeFi strategies, the execution counterparties, and strategy-level custody are not published.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-3 (lead usdd-tron-dao-reserve)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: The OTF model is on-chain fundraising, off-chain execution, on-chain settlement: deposited funds leave the BNB Chain vault into strategy execution, and Lorenzo's own disclaimer states it 'does not manage user funds and is not responsible for the performance of any underlying strategy'. Who holds strategy assets off-chain (custodians, prime brokers, exchanges), whether accounts are segregated, and what insolvency treatment applies are all undisclosed, so segregation is unknown and no bankruptcy-remoteness structure is documented (recorded as none). Active deployment of vault assets into off-chain strategies is the disclosed design, recorded as permitted rehypothecation of the reserve. Separately, the sUSD1+ BSC proxy implementation is unverified and its upgrade authority unresolved (mintAuthority review, 2026-06-11). Withdrawals follow a 7-day minimum hold plus a biweekly settlement cycle, so exit liquidity depends on strategy settlement rather than instant on-chain redemption.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: sUSD1+ is the strategy-bearing staked layer and intentionally departs from the USD1 fiat-reserve parent mechanism.
